front_content.text:
原句：数字化社区服务平台优化了公共资源配置，也提升了基层治理响应速度。

任务：先汉译英，再选出双结果并列表达最稳的一项。

back_content.text: Digital community service platforms have optimized the allocation of public resources and improved the responsiveness of grassroots governance.
back_content.explanation: 句子核心是“资源配置优化 + 治理响应提升”并列结果，需保持同层谓语。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文中“也”连接两个治理成效，属于并列增益结构。

② 核心规律：并列结果表达中，谓语应平行（have optimized ... and improved ...），避免一端主句一端从句导致重心失衡。

③ 验证：正确译文中两项结果都由平台驱动，逻辑连贯，语体符合社会治理语境。
tips: 并列结果句先做“主语-谓语平行”检查。
社会治理语料常用名词化结果槽位提升正式度。

options.text: Digital community service platforms have optimized the allocation of public resources and improved the responsiveness of grassroots governance.
Digital community service platforms have optimized public resource allocation, which improved grassroots governance responsiveness.
The allocation of public resources has been optimized and the responsiveness of grassroots governance improve by digital community service platforms.
Digital community service platforms optimize the allocation of public resources and grassroots governance is responsive improved.

front_content.text:
原句：公共政策的人本导向往往体现在对弱势群体的持续关注中。

先做汉译英，再补全骨架：
The people-centered orientation of public policy is often reflected {{blank}} sustained attention to vulnerable groups.

back_content.text: The people-centered orientation of public policy is often reflected in sustained attention to vulnerable groups.
back_content.explanation: reflected in 是固定搭配，用于表达“体现在……之中”。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“体现在……中”通常对应固定介词搭配。

② 核心规律：be reflected in ... 是高频正式表达，能稳定承载抽象政策导向与具体实践之间的映射关系。

③ 验证：填 in 后，句子完整表达“导向—体现形式”的逻辑链，语义准确。
tips: 抽象概念表达优先固定搭配，避免临场拼接。
政策语体里 reflected in 出现频率高，值得模板化记忆。

front_content.text:
原句：平台经济催生的新就业形态，为更多劳动者提供了灵活就业机会。

任务：先汉译英，再核对定语信息是否准确限定“就业形态”。

back_content.text: New forms of employment generated by the platform economy have provided more flexible job opportunities for workers.
back_content.explanation: generated by ... 压缩被动定语，提升句子紧凑度。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“催生的……形态”是被动定语。

② 核心规律：generated by ... 可替代 that are generated by ...，常用于经济主题。

③ 验证与纠偏：修饰对象 forms of employment 清晰，主句结果完整。
tips: 经济语境常用 generated by ... 表示“由……催生”。
flexible job opportunities 对应“灵活就业机会”。

front_content.text:
原句：那些能够及时响应市场变化的企业，更容易在竞争中保持韧性。

任务：先汉译英，再选出限制性从句最准确的一项。

back_content.text: Enterprises that can respond to market changes in a timely manner are more likely to remain resilient in competition.
back_content.explanation: that can respond ... 限定企业群体，主句表达竞争结果。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“那些能够……的企业”要求限制性定语从句。

② 核心规律：respond to ... in a timely manner 是正式语体中的稳定搭配。

③ 验证与纠偏：A 结构完整；其余项在词形或主谓一致上存在错误。
tips: 限制性从句先确保关系词和先行词匹配。
remain resilient 是“保持韧性”的高频搭配。

options.text: Enterprises that can respond to market changes in a timely manner are more likely to remain resilient in competition.
Enterprises which can responds to market changes in a timely manner are more likely to remain resilient in competition.
Enterprises that can respond to market changes in a timely manner is more likely to remain resilient in competition.
Enterprises that can respond to market changes in a timely manner are more likely remain resilient in competition.

front_content.text:
原句：政府完善的公共就业服务体系，为青年群体提供了更精准的岗位匹配支持。

先做汉译英，再补全骨架：
The public employment service system {{blank}} by the government has provided young people with more precise job-matching support.

back_content.text: The public employment service system improved by the government has provided young people with more precise job-matching support.
back_content.explanation: improved by ... 压缩被动定语，突出体系来源。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“完善的……体系”可还原为被动定语。

② 核心规律：体系类先行词可用 improved by ... 形成简洁定语结构。

③ 验证与纠偏：填 improved 后，定语和主句边界清楚，语义自然。
tips: 被动定语先看能否压缩为 done by ...。
job-matching support 对应“岗位匹配支持”。

front_content.text:
原句：那些能够把技术创新转化为产业效益的团队，更可能实现可持续增长。

任务：先汉译英，再选出定语从句和主谓一致都正确的一项。

back_content.text: Teams that can transform technological innovation into industrial benefits are more likely to achieve sustainable growth.
back_content.explanation: that can transform ... 限定团队类型，主句给出增长结果。

analysis_content.text:
① 识别信号：中文“那些能够……的团队”需限制性从句。

② 核心规律：can 后动词保持原形，复数主语 teams 对应 are more likely。

③ 验证与纠偏：A 在关系从句、词形与主谓一致上均正确。
tips: 限制性从句要同时检查关系词与动词形式。
transform ... into ... 是“转化为”的稳定搭配。

options.text: Teams that can transform technological innovation into industrial benefits are more likely to achieve sustainable growth.
Teams which can transforms technological innovation into industrial benefits are more likely to achieve sustainable growth.
Teams that can transform technological innovation into industrial benefits is more likely to achieve sustainable growth.
